description: I'll strongly advocate for making Connecticut more affordable, halting the exodus of residents, and restoring our state's appeal to businesses and citizens. With government employees retiring, it's an ideal moment to refocus on essential agency functions. Connecticut's loss of residents to lower-tax states underscores the urgency of tax reduction and limited government. As retirements occur, we must seize the opportunity to streamline departments, concentrating on core functions.
title: Economic Freedom | DeCaprio 4 CT 48th
